Trace, implement and test: 剑指 Offer II 081. 允许重复选择元素的组合

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    vector<vector<int>> ans;
    vector<int> candidates;
    int target;

    vector<vector<int>> combinationSum(vector<int>& candidates, int target) {
        this->candidates = candidates;
        this->target = target;
        vector<int> t;
        dfs(0, 0, t);
        return ans;
    }

    void dfs(int s, int u, vector<int>& t) {
        if (s == target) {
            ans.push_back(t);
            return;
        }
        if (s > target) return;
        for (int i = u; i < candidates.size(); ++i) {
            int c = candidates[i];
            t.push_back(c);
            dfs(s + c, i, t);
            t.pop_back();
        }
    }
};
